objective: Preallocate trigram-index top-level maps for the first indexed table.

tasks.title: Preallocate trigram-index top-level maps
tasks.result: TrigramIndex initialization now reserves capacity for the first postings table and row-id table entries.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
This complements BENCHPROD-271, which preallocated maps created during the first trigram insertion.
The initial top-level capacity is 1 because a newly constructed trigram index commonly receives its first indexed table immediately after initialization.
The optimization only changes initial HashMap allocation for empty top-level postings and row-id maps; trigram extraction, index updates, persistence, LIKE lookup, and row-key mapping are unchanged.
